keep working where CDNs are slow or filtered.

| `fonts/Vazirmatn-Variable.woff2` | [Vazirmatn](https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn) v33.003 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |
